info.title: pixeltwin
info.description: Self-hosted visual regression testing. Each operation lists its required permission in `x-permission`. Agents: start with /llms.txt.

autoApproveNew.description: A new screenshot (no baseline yet) is approved as soon as it arrives

agentReview.description: What a project token's approve or reject does. off: it applies. suggest: it is recorded as a suggestion and the check stays pending until a person accepts or dismisses it. auto-below: approvals of a diff up to agentMaxDiffPercent apply, others (and new screenshots) become suggestions; rejections apply. Unless off, a token must give a reason.

agentMaxDiffPercent.description: With agentReview "auto-below": the largest diff percent a token may approve itself

token.description: The full token. Shown only in this response.

parallelTotal.description: A parallel build: how many parts (CI jobs) finalize it; null for an ordinary build

partsFinished.description: Parts of a parallel build that have finalized it

timing.description: How long pixeltwin took, in ms: what the SDK measured for `checks` checks (screenshots, uploads, retakes) and the server time of every check (compareMs)

autoApproved.description: Approved by the project's auto-approve-new setting (part of review.approved)

withAreas.description: Checks whose snapshot has drawn ignore or compare areas

suggested.description: Checks with an agent's open suggestion, waiting for a person to accept or dismiss it

recent.description: The last 10 builds of the branch, newest first

elementCount.description: Page elements the SDK sent with the screenshot; null when none

suggestion.description: An agent's open suggestion (agent review policy): the check stays pending until a person accepts or dismisses it

compareMs.description: Server time this check took, in ms: baseline, compare and store

supersededBy.description: Set when review is "outdated": the check of a newer build of this branch whose approval decided this screen.

changes.description: Element by element (moved, resized, text, style, added, removed), most important first, at most 50. Only when both the baseline and this check came with elements; then the summary names elements too.

kind.description: The most telling aspect: added or removed, else text, style, resized, moved

key.description: The element: [data-testid=…], #id, role=…[name="…"] or a CSS path (the baseline key for removed)

label.description: How the summary names the element

from.description: Box in the baseline, screenshot pixels; null when added

to.description: Box in the new screenshot; null when removed

dy.description: Moved down by this many pixels (negative: up)

inside.description: Elements inside it that changed the same way (not listed on their own)

regions.description: Indexes into diff.regions that this change explains

outcome.description: applied: the check is approved or rejected. suggested: the project's agent review policy recorded a token's review as a suggestion; the check stays pending until a person accepts or dismisses it

kind.description: ignore: skip these pixels; compare: compare only inside the compare areas.

actor.description: The user or project token that acted (an id, like reviewedBy).

actorKind.description: user: a person; token: a project token (an agent or CI); auto: auto-approve-new

actorName.description: The token's name when it acted; null for people

post.summary: Create the first admin with the setup token printed in the server log
Log in; sets the pt_session cookie
Get a personal token (Bearer pu_…) for a page served elsewhere, such as a test report
post.description: Same credentials and limits as login, but no cookie: the token acts as the user (with their role) when sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, expires like a session, and ends when the password changes.

201.description: The personal token and its user

post.summary: Log out and end the session
Create a user (there is no self-registration)

patch.summary: Change a user's email or role

delete.summary: Delete a user (never the last admin)

get.summary: List projects (a token sees only its own)

post.summary: Create a project

delete.summary: Delete a project with its builds, baselines and tokens

get.summary: List a project's tokens (never their secrets)

post.summary: Create a project token for CI or an agent
Open a build (idempotent on externalId)

200.description: The existing build with this externalId

get.summary: List branches with their latest build: main first, then by latest build (at most 50)
Get a build with its verdict and counts

delete.summary: Delete a build with its checks; baselines approved in it stay

post.summary: Finalize a build and get its verdict (CI gate: only "passed" is success)
post.description: A part of a parallel build sends `{ "part": "<CI job id>" }`: the build stays open until every one of its `parallelTotal` parts has finalized it. Without a body the build is finalized at once.

200.description: The build: finalized, or still open while parts of a parallel build run

post.summary: Add what an SDK worker measured (screenshots, uploads, retakes) to the build's timing
post.description: Additive: each worker of a run sends its own totals once, also after the build is finalized.

post.summary: Approve every pending check in the build. A token's approvals may become suggestions (agent review policy)

200.description: Number of checks approved, and of suggestions recorded

suggested.description: Recorded as suggestions for a person to accept

post.summary: Post a screenshot; it is compared with its baseline before the response

meta.description: Check metadata as JSON (name, variant, ignoreRegions, thresholds)

200.description: The check replaced an earlier one for the same snapshot

get.summary: List a build's checks, oldest first
Get a check with its diff

post.summary: Approve a check; its image becomes the baseline. A token's approval may be recorded as a suggestion (see outcome)

200.description: The check, and whether the review applied or became a suggestion

post.summary: Reject a check. A token's rejection may be recorded as a suggestion (see outcome)

200.description: The check, and whether the review applied or became a suggestion

post.summary: Accept an agent's suggestion: approve or reject as it suggested, with its reason (people only)
Dismiss an agent's suggestion; the check keeps waiting for a review

get.summary: The page elements sent with the check and with the baseline it was compared with

200.description: Elements (boxes in screenshot pixels); null where the SDK sent none

post.summary: Undo a review: back to pending. Undoing an approval removes the baseline it created, unless a newer one replaced it (409 review_not_resettable)

get.summary: Ignore and compare areas drawn on the check's snapshot (they apply to every check of it)

post.summary: Draw an area on the check's snapshot; the check is compared again at once

201.description: The area and the check compared again

post.summary: Ignore all changes: an ignore area around each change of the check; compared again at once

201.description: The new areas and the check

patch.summary: Move or resize an area (its kind stays); the check is compared again at once

200.description: The area and the check compared again

delete.summary: Delete an area; the check is compared again at once

get.summary: Review history of a check: every approval, rejection and undo, newest first
A snapshot's baseline history, newest first
What promoting the branch would change: its screens whose baseline differs from main's

200.description: Screens that would change on main

post.summary: Copy a branch's current baselines to the main branch (after merging), all or some
post.description: URL-encode the branch name: `feature%2Flogin`. Without a body every differing screen is promoted; `snapshotKeys` picks some.

get.summary: Download a screenshot, baseline or diff image (PNG)
